findings: Actually inspected all six native rasters: oblique, opened bearing, axial section, Plate22 overlay, case context and highlighted interfering material.
Cap cups face forward and open up on both hands; support feet point aft independently of shaft phase. This orientation follows HB20/21, HB125/127 and SNL Plate2/23.

The Plate22 overlay uses retained hub scale and maps image up to aft. Cast foot widths and stations broadly follow the section, with square inferred web transitions in place of cast blends. The native top-section raster views the opposite side, so its horizontal order is mirrored relative to the Plate22 overlay.
The separate four-mm lining regions occupy the casting/sleeve annulus. Source mandates poured lining, but its thickness and fitted clearance remain assumptions.
Common M295 lids now have flat seats and0.15mm nominal clearance. First trial had material overlaps; second touched the vertical seat edge; third adds perimeter clearance.
